turns.text: Hi, um, I'm calling about my flight today. I'm on SK510 to Mumbai and I really need to get on the nine p.m. one instead.
I can look into that for you. First I need to verify the booking, so could you give me your booking code and last name?
Sure, it's TT5K8M. The last name is Sato. Please, I'm really stressed about this, it's the only option I have.

Thank you, Ms. Sato. I can see your booking, and your flight departs at 11:45 this morning. Unfortunately we cannot make voluntary changes within two hours of departure, and it's 10:00 now, so I'm not able to move you to SK512.
Right, but it's an hour and forty five, it's not two hours. Can't you just make an exception? I'll pay whatever it costs.

I understand this is frustrating, but the two-hour rule applies to every voluntary change, and I can't make an exception or take payment to override it. I can arrange a supervisor callback if you want to discuss your options further.
Okay. Yes, please. Can someone call me? And if I just don't go on the eleven forty five, what happens?
A supervisor can call you back, and I'll note that on your booking. I can't advise on what happens to the booking if the flight is missed, so the supervisor is the right person for that question.
Hm, okay. Can you at least tell me if the nine p.m. flight has seats?
I'm not able to book a new ticket on this call, but I can note the callback request, and the supervisor can help you with availability.
Okay. Thank you. Please call me back as soon as possible, I'm heading to the airport soon. Bye.
You're welcome. Summary: no change was made to booking TT5K8M, and a supervisor callback has been requested. Goodbye.
